head.h1: Farewell Catering in Dubai — Prices, Formats and What You Get

opening_paragraph: Farewell catering in Dubai from myCHEF starts at AED 700 per person , with a private chef who plans the menu, cooks on site, serves your guests and clears everything away. A leaving party is about the person at the centre of it, so the food should run itself while you spend the evening with them. Share the date, the headcount and the venue, we typically reply within 15 minutes during business hours, with an itemised proposal to follow you can read at a glance.

new_paragraphs: How much does farewell catering cost in Dubai?

Farewell catering costs from AED 700 per person, with the final figure set by guest count, menu and service level. A drop-off buffet is the most affordable; plated service with full staff is the premium end. Send your numbers for an itemised quote.
What is included in farewell catering?

Included is the full service: menu design, a private chef cooking on site, service staff, all serving equipment, setup and complete cleanup. One team covers everything from planning to the last cleared plate.
How far ahead should I book farewell catering?
Book at least a week ahead for a small gathering, and earlier for large parties or peak dates. If your date is soon, ask anyway — we can often accommodate short notice depending on chef availability.
Can you cater a corporate farewell at our office?

Yes. Corporate farewell catering at offices is one of our most common briefs, from a relaxed lunch send-off to an after-work canapés-and-drinks reception. We work around your building's kitchen, timing and security requirements.
Do you offer halal and dietary-specific farewell menus?
Every menu is halal by default, and we design vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free and nut-free options into the same spread. Tell us the dietary needs in your group and no guest is handed a lesser plate.
Can I hire a private chef instead of a buffet?

Yes, you can. Alongside buffet and grazing formats you can hire a private farewell chef for a plated, multi-course dinner cooked in your home. It is the more intimate, luxury route for a small, close farewell.
For farewell catering, the chefs and partner kitchens handling your booking operate to Dubai Municipality food-safety requirements .

replace_in_block.new_heading: What is on a farewell catering menu?
new_paragraphs: Every farewell menu is built bespoke, but most start from one of a few reliable shapes. A shared buffet or grazing table works hardest for mingling crowds; canapés and drinks suit a stand-up evening; a dessert table gives the night a sweet finish and a natural moment for speeches. Popular choices for the farewell food itself span Mediterranean mezze, slow-cooked mains, fresh salads and a signature dessert tied to the guest of honour's favourites. Dietary needs are designed in from the start — halal by default, plus vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free and nut-free options woven through the same menu so no one is handed a lesser plate. If you want a theme, a nod to where the person is heading next, or a dish from their home country, the chef will build it in. This is the affordable, flexible middle ground between a restaurant booking and doing it all yourself.

add_block.new_heading: What does farewell catering in Dubai include?
new_paragraphs: It includes everything from the first menu conversation to the last cleared plate, delivered by one team so you are not chasing separate suppliers. When you hire farewell catering, a vetted private farewell chef designs the menu with you, shops for the ingredients, cooks fresh in your kitchen or a prep space, and brings service staff to pour, plate and top up throughout the night. Setup, serving equipment, and full cleanup are part of the same service. Because we work as a private chef catering company instead of a mass-production kitchen, the food is cooked for your guest count, not reheated from trays. That is the difference between a warm send-off and a functional one — and it is why most hosts book a proper caterer for a farewell instead of ordering platters.

add_block.new_heading: Farewell catering for corporate leaving parties, offices and family send-offs
new_paragraphs: Whichever kind of goodbye it is, the format bends to the occasion, not the other way round. A corporate farewell catering brief for a colleague leaving the firm usually wants relaxed canapés and drinks that let people mingle and speak, so we lean on a grazing table or roaming service. Office farewells over lunch call for something quicker and generous; a family send-off before a big move suits a shared buffet every guest can gather around. We handle small home gatherings and larger farewell party catering for events across the city with the same team. Tell us the tone — sentimental dinner, lively celebration, or a quiet last meal with close friends — and the farewell party catering is built to match it, from the menu down to how the room is set.

add_block.new_heading: Styling, timing and logistics for a farewell party
new_paragraphs: Good farewell catering is as much about flow as flavour, so we plan the evening as a timeline. The chef arrives early to set up, food lands when guests are ready, not the moment they walk in, and staff keep the buffet or grazing table looking full through the busy stretch. We coordinate around speeches and toasts so the room is settled and served when it matters, and we scale service staff to your headcount so drinks and plates not stall. Whether it is a villa, an apartment, a rooftop or an office, we adapt to the kitchen and power available on site. At the end, our team clears, packs down and leaves the space as we found it — the last thing you want after a send-off is a sink full of dishes.

add_block.new_heading: How much does farewell catering cost in Dubai?
new_paragraphs: Farewell catering prices start from AED 700 per person, and the format is what moves the number. A drop-off buffet is the most affordable per guest; a shared buffet with on-site service sits in the middle; plated fine dining with full staff is the top end. Guest count, menu complexity and service level are the three levers, which is why we quote every event individually instead of posting a fixed farewell catering cost. Catering packages that bundle menu, chef and service tend to give the best value once you are over a dozen guests. For a full breakdown of what drives the price and how to compare quotes properly, see our Dubai catering price guide , then send your numbers for an itemised, no-surprises proposal.

add_block.new_heading: How to hire farewell catering and how it works
new_paragraphs: Hiring is a short, four-step path from enquiry to a served evening. First, send the date, guest count and venue, and we typically reply within 15 minutes during business hours. Second, we propose a bespoke menu and an itemised quote — no deposit to see it. Third, you confirm and we lock your chef and service team for the date. Fourth, on the day the chef arrives early, cooks, serves and cleans up while you host. For a small gathering a week's notice is usually plenty; large parties and peak dates should be booked earlier. Looking for farewell catering near me search results rarely tell you who does the cooking — with myCHEF you know the named chef and their record before you commit.

new_paragraphs: MyCHEF was founded by a chef trained in some of Europe's most demanding kitchens, on one idea: you own the evening, we carry the work. Vetting for farewell catering means identity checks, a practical cooking assessment, reference verification and ongoing performance reviews — a continuous standard, not a one-time tick. We are honest about it, too: no system removes every risk, so we match each event to the right chef for it.

For a farewell, that is often Ahmed Al-Rashid — 18+ years across Dubai, London and Paris in classical French technique — who designs each menu as a collaboration with the host, every course timed, seasoned and served to exacting standards. Farewell catering sits alongside villa weddings, yacht celebrations and corporate galas we have delivered across Dubai; recently we catered a leaving dinner for a departing regional director in Business Bay, matching a plated menu to guests from four countries in a single evening. Every farewell catering booking includes, with client reviews added as events run.

add_block.new_heading: Planning farewell catering step by step
new_paragraphs: Send your date, guest count and venue — your proposal arrives.
Book farewell catering about 2 weeks ahead off-peak, and 6 weeks ahead between November and March.
Confirm the menu roughly 7 days before, once your numbers settle.
Ask about dietary covers for farewell catering when you enquire, not inside the final 48 hours .
Check venue access and parking for farewell catering; the team arrives about 2 hours before service.
Plan on roughly 3 hours of service, and add 5% VAT to the total.
